summary: Recent advancements in AI technology highlight significant societal implications and growth in the field. OpenAI is expanding its Daybreak program to bolster Ukraine's cyber defenses, showcasing a commitment to social good. Additionally, OpenAI's partnership with Grab aims to equip 30,000 individuals in Southeast Asia with practical AI skills, emphasizing the importance of AI education. Google DeepMind's launch of Gemini 3.8 enhances AI system capabilities, while TrustedRouter's $1.25 million funding reflects increasing investor interest in AI-driven security solutions. Innovative tools like AI·rete·RAG and Agenttik are emerging, offering decision-making capabilities and project management assistance, respectively, indicating diverse applications across industries.
recommendations: Focus on the most impactful advancements in AI technology and their implications for society.
Highlight partnerships and funding that demonstrate the growth and direction of AI applications.
Emphasize tools that offer innovative solutions and their potential uses in various industries.

items.original: New experts join Google’s AI & Economy team. We are expanding our AI & Economy team with world-class academic advisors, fellows, and core internal researchers.
items.rewritten: Google's AI & Economy team is growing by adding top academic advisors, fellows, and internal researchers. This expansion aims to enhance their expertise and capabilities in the field of AI and its economic implications.

items.original: How UK AISI and EvalEval Are Making Benchmark Results Reproducible
items.rewritten: The UK AISI and EvalEval initiatives are working to ensure that benchmark results in AI research are reproducible. This effort is crucial for validating findings and improving the reliability of AI models.

items.original: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
items.rewritten: Google DeepMind has announced the launch of Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking. These new versions aim to enhance the capabilities of AI systems. The updates are expected to improve performance and user experience.

items.original: I track LLM API prices daily, found a 33x cost gap in the same model
items.rewritten: A user reports tracking the prices of large language model (LLM) APIs daily and has discovered a significant price difference—up to 33 times—within the same model. This finding emphasizes the variability in costs associated with AI services. It suggests that users should be cautious and informed when selecting API providers.

items.original: Show HN: AI startup TrustedRouter raises $1.25M
items.rewritten: An AI startup called TrustedRouter has successfully raised $1.25 million in funding. This achievement indicates growing investor interest in AI-driven solutions. TrustedRouter aims to enhance security and trust in digital communications.

items.original: Tell HN: Anthropic should make Claude the Author and me the Co-Author
items.rewritten: A user on Hacker News suggests that Anthropic should credit their AI model, Claude, as the author of a work, with the user being listed as a co-author. This raises interesting questions about authorship and collaboration between humans and AI. The proposal highlights the evolving relationship between creators and AI tools.

items.original: OpenAI extends cyber access to Ukraine for civilian defense. OpenAI is extending access to its Daybreak program to the Government of Ukraine to support the cyber defense of civilian infrastructure.
items.rewritten: OpenAI is expanding its Daybreak program to support the Government of Ukraine in defending civilian infrastructure against cyber threats. This initiative aims to enhance Ukraine's cyber defense capabilities. The move underscores OpenAI's commitment to using technology for social good.

items.original: Grab and OpenAI bring practical AI skills to Southeast Asia. OpenAI and Grab launch GO Forward with AI, a regional programme helping 30,000 partners build practical AI skills across Southeast Asia.
items.rewritten: OpenAI and Grab have partnered to launch a program called GO Forward with AI in Southeast Asia. This initiative aims to help 30,000 partners develop practical AI skills. The collaboration highlights the importance of AI education in the region.

items.original: Show HN: AI·rete·RAG – a Rete rule engine decides, RAG explains why
items.rewritten: AI·rete·RAG is a tool that uses a Rete rule engine to make decisions. It also provides explanations for those decisions using a method called RAG.

items.original: Show HN: Agenttik – work on multiple projects in parallel with AI agents
items.rewritten: Agenttik is a platform that allows users to manage and work on multiple projects simultaneously with the help of AI agents.

dropped.original: Ask HN: So is AI taking our jobs?
dropped.rewritten: A discussion on Hacker News raises the question of whether artificial intelligence is taking away jobs from people. This topic has become increasingly relevant as AI technology continues to advance. Many are concerned about the potential impact on employment.

dropped.rewritten: Diffusion PDF is a tool that integrates a diffusion image model directly into a PDF file, allowing for advanced image processing within that format.
